title: 3D Music Ball Hop
description: Bounce a glowing rhythm orb across floating neon tiles to the beat—glide smoothly left and right to nail every center landing and keep the melody soaring.
controls: Press and drag left or right to guide the bouncing ball onto every glowing rhythm tile in sync with the beat.

zh-CN.title: 3D 音乐球
zh-CN.description: 超火动感电音节奏 3D 音乐球：跟随节拍单指滑动控制炫光小球精准踩点跳跃，沉浸式踩节拍爽到停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 按住左右拖动控制弹跳光球稳稳落到每一块发光音符砖块上，连击飙分。
